knit: (function(input, ...) {

      input,
      knit_root_dir = here::here(),
      output_dir = 'out',
      output_file = paste0(xfun::sans_ext(basename(input)), '_', format(Sys.Date(),format="%d%b%Y"), '.html'),
      envir = globalenv()

output:

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# set up output html figures to be in SVG format
# set up current working directory to be the project directory
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE,dev='svg',root.dir = rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file())
date.stamp <- format(Sys.Date(),format="%d%b%Y")
print(rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file())
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir=rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file())

# THIS NEEDS TO BE EDITED
this.analysis <- "analyze_DMC_25Q3_long_read_RNAseq"

# output files will be prefixed with this.analysis and placed in the "out" folder
filestamp <- function(x) {
  paste0('out/',this.analysis,"_",xfun::sans_ext(x),"_", format(Sys.Date(),format="%d%b%Y"), ".",xfun::file_ext(x))
}

# Functions to get date and time
getDate <- function() format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")
getTime <- function() format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S")

# copy snapshot of this Rmd to output folder
this.rmd <- knitr::current_input()
if(!is.null(this.rmd)) {
system(paste0("cp src/",
              this.rmd,
              " ",
              paste0("out/",xfun::sans_ext(this.rmd),'_',format(Sys.Date(),format="%d%b%Y"),".",xfun::file_ext(this.rmd))
))
}

```

## Configuration

```{r}

# I/O
depmapDataDir <- file.path("data", "DMC_26Q1")
olinkDataDir <- file.path("data", "Olink_26Q1")
projDir <- file.path("~/Projects/DMC_long_read_RNAseq")
gtfDir <- file.path(projDir, "out", "filtered_GTF_files")
analysis_outdir <- file.path(projDir, "out", this.analysis)
outdir <- file.path(analysis_outdir, getDate())
volPlotDir <- file.path(outdir, "volcano_plots")
boxplotDir <- file.path(outdir, "boxplots")

if(!dir.exists(gtfDir)) dir.create(gtfDir, recursive = TRUE)
if(!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)
if(!dir.exists(volPlotDir)) dir.create(volPlotDir, recursive = TRUE)
if(!dir.exists(boxplotDir)) dir.create(boxplotDir, recursive = TRUE)

if(length(list.files(depmapDataDir)) <= 1) system("axe-cloud-fuser mount --path buckets.yaml")

```

## Generate table of canonical transcripts from Ensembl Biomart

```{r}

txp_annot_file <- file.path(projDir, "data","ensembl_transcript_annotation.txt")

if(!file.exists(txp_annot_file))
{
  # Get table from biomaRt for converting outdated gene names
  mart <- useEnsembl(biomart = "genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
  
  txp_annot <- getBM(attributes = c("uniprotswissprot",
                                    "hgnc_symbol",
                                    "ensembl_gene_id",
                                    # "entrezgene_id",
                                    # "external_gene_name",
                                    # "external_synonym",
                                    "ensembl_transcript_id",
                                    "transcript_is_canonical"),
                      mart = mart) %>%
                mutate(transcript_is_canonical = case_when(transcript_is_canonical == 1 ~ TRUE, .default = FALSE))

  write_tsv(txp_annot, txp_annot_file)
} else {
  txp_annot <- read_tsv(txp_annot_file) %>% as.data.frame()
}

# Get gene annotation
gene_annot <- txp_annot %>%
              group_by(uniprotswissprot, hgnc_symbol, ensembl_gene_id, entrezgene_id) %>%
              summarise() %>%
              ungroup() %>%
              as.data.frame()

```

## Load surface protein annotations

```{r}

gene_prot_annot <- read_tsv(file.path("data", "gene_protein_annotation.txt"), name_repair = "universal_quiet") %>%
                   group_by(UniProtKB.Swiss.Prot.ID, HGNC.symbol) %>%
                   summarise() %>%
                   ungroup() %>%
                   filter(!is.na(UniProtKB.Swiss.Prot.ID) & !is.na(HGNC.symbol)) %>%
                   as.data.frame()

## Cell surface protein atlas ##

cspa <- read_excel(file.path("data", "CSPA_validated_cell_surface_proteins.xlsx"), sheet = "Table A", .name_repair = "universal_quiet") %>%
        filter(organism == "Human" & CSPA.category == "1 - high confidence") %>%
        group_by(ID_link, ENTREZ_gene_ID, ENTREZ.gene.symbol, protein.probability, UniProt.Cell.surface) %>%
        summarise() %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        as.data.frame()

miss_cspa <- cspa %>% filter(!ENTREZ.gene.symbol %in% gene_annot$HGNC.symbol) %>%
                      left_join(select(gene_annot, ID_link = uniprotswissprot, hgnc_symbol), by = "ID_link") %>%
                      mutate(ENTREZ.gene.symbol = case_when(!is.na(hgnc_symbol) ~ hgnc_symbol, .default = ENTREZ.gene.symbol)) %>%
                      select(-hgnc_symbol)

cspa %<>% filter(!ENTREZ_gene_ID %in% miss_cspa$ENTREZ_gene_ID) %>%
          bind_rows(miss_cspa)

## Ensembl cell membrane/surface proteins ##

uniprot_annot <- read_tsv(file.path("data", "uniprot_surface_membrane.tsv")) %>%
                  filter(!grepl("secreted", `Subcellular location [CC]`, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
                  filter(!grepl("endoplasmic reticulum|golgi|mitochondrion|lysosome", `Subcellular location [CC]`, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
                  filter(grepl("extracellular", `Topological domain`, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
                  separate_longer_delim(`Gene Names`, delim = " ") %>%
                  as.data.frame()

## Bausch, Fluck et al surface proteins ##

bf_annot <- read_excel(file.path("data", "bausch_fluck_surfaceome.xlsx"), sheet = 2, skip = 1) %>%
            select(`UniProt name`, `UniProt accession`, `UniProt gene`, `Surfaceome Label`, length, `TM domains`, signalpeptide, `Ensembl gene`) %>%
            as.data.frame()

```

## Load DMC 26Q1 long-read RNA-seq data

```{r}

lr_exp_file <- file.path(depmapDataDir, "OmicsLongReadExpressionTranscriptlogp1HumanAllGenesPlusNovel.csv")
lr_count_file <- file.path(depmapDataDir, "OmicsLongReadExpressionTranscriptRawReadCountHumanAllGenesPlusNovel.csv")
lr_gtf_file <- file.path(depmapDataDir, "OmicsLongReadGTF.gtf")
lr_exp_outfile <- file.path(projDir, "out", this.analysis, "longread_RNAseq_novel_isoforms_log2TPM.txt")
lr_gtf_outfile <- file.path(projDir, "out", this.analysis, "longread_RNAseq_transcripts.gtf")
lr_gtf_exons_outfile<- file.path(projDir, "out", this.analysis, "longread_RNAseq_transcripts_and_exons.gtf")
novel_surf_gtf_outfile <- file.path(projDir, "out", this.analysis, "longread_RNAseq_novel_surfaceome_isoforms.gtf")
surf_gtf_outfile <- file.path(projDir, "out", this.analysis, "longread_RNAseq_all_surfaceome_isoforms.gtf")

# Read metadata and filter for AML cell lines
all_mtdt <- read_csv(file.path(depmapDataDir, "Model.csv")) %>% as.data.frame()

## Load log2TPM data and convert to TPM ##

lr_exp <- as.data.frame(fread(lr_exp_file)) %>%
          filter(IsDefaultEntryForModel == "Yes") %>%
          select(-V1, -SequencingID, -ModelConditionID, -IsDefaultEntryForModel, -IsDefaultEntryForMC)

invisible(gc())

# Convert data to gene x model matrix
expr_mat_log <- lr_exp %>%
                column_to_rownames(var = "ModelID") %>%
                t()

# Create table with linear TPM data
expr_mat_tpm <- 2^expr_mat_log - 1
expr_mat_tpm[expr_mat_tpm < 0] <- 0

rm("lr_exp")
invisible(gc())

## Load raw readcounts data ##

lr_count <- as.data.frame(fread(lr_count_file)) %>%
            filter(IsDefaultEntryForModel == "Yes") %>%
            select(-V1, -SequencingID, -ModelConditionID, -IsDefaultEntryForModel, -IsDefaultEntryForMC)

invisible(gc())

# Convert data to gene x model matrix
counts <- lr_count %>%
          column_to_rownames(var = "ModelID") %>%
          t()

rm(lr_count)
invisible(gc())

## Load transcript GTF file ##

if(!file.exists(lr_gtf_outfile))
{
  # lr_gtf_gawk_cmd <- paste0("gawk 'BEGIN {FS=\",\"} {if(NR == 1 || ($3 == \"IsoQuant\" && $10 ~ /", paste(unique(cspa$ENTREZ.gene.symbol), collapse = "|"), "/) {print $0}}' ", lr_gtf_file)
  # lr_gtf_gawk_cmd <- paste0("gawk 'BEGIN {FS=\",\"} {if(NR == 1 || ($3 == \"IsoQuant\" && $4 == \"transcript\")) {print $0}}' ", lr_gtf_file)
  lr_gtf_gawk_cmd <- paste0("gawk 'BEGIN {FS=\",\"} {if(NR == 1 || $4 == \"transcript\" || $4 == \"exon\") {print $0}}' ", lr_gtf_file)
  lr_gtf <- as.data.frame(fread(cmd = lr_gtf_gawk_cmd, sep = ","))
  
  lr_gtf <- lr_gtf[-1, -1]
  colnames(lr_gtf) <- c("seqname", "source", "feature", "start", "end", "score", "strand", "frame", "attribute")
  
  novel_gtf <- lr_gtf %>%
                filter(source == "IsoQuant") %>%
                separate(attribute, into = c("transcript_id", "gene_id", "gene_name"), sep = "; ") %>%
                mutate(transcript_id = gsub("transcript_id ", "", transcript_id),
                       gene_id = gsub("gene_id ", "", gene_id),
                       gene_name = gsub("gene_name ", "", gene_name),
                       transcript_id = gsub("\"", "", transcript_id),
                       gene_id = gsub("\"", "", gene_id),
                       gene_name = gsub("\"", "", gene_name))
  known_gtf <- lr_gtf %>%
                filter(source != "IsoQuant") %>%
                separate(attribute, into = c("gene_id", "transcript_id", "gene_type", "gene_name"), sep = "; ") %>%
                select(-gene_type) %>%
                mutate(transcript_id = gsub("transcript_id ", "", transcript_id),
                       gene_id = gsub("gene_id ", "", gene_id),
                       gene_name = gsub("gene_name ", "", gene_name),
                       transcript_id = gsub("\"", "", transcript_id),
                       gene_id = gsub("\"", "", gene_id),
                       gene_name = gsub("\"", "", gene_name))
  
  lr_gtf_with_exons <- bind_rows(novel_gtf, known_gtf) %>%
                        mutate(Uniprot_surface = case_when(gene_name %in% uniprot_annot$`Gene Names` ~ TRUE,
                                                           .default = FALSE),
                               CSPA_surface = case_when(gene_name %in% cspa$ENTREZ.gene.symbol ~ TRUE,
                                                        .default = FALSE),
                               Bausch_Fluck_surface = case_when(gene_name %in% bf_annot$`UniProt gene` |
                                                                  str_extract(gene_id, "[^\\.]+") %in% bf_annot$`Ensembl gene` ~ TRUE,
                                                                .default = FALSE))
  
  lr_gtf <- lr_gtf_with_exons %>% filter(feature == "transcript")
  
  rm("novel_gtf", "known_gtf")
  
  invisible(gc())
  
  write_tsv(lr_gtf, lr_gtf_outfile)
  write_tsv(lr_gtf_with_exons, lr_gtf_exons_outfile)
  
  novel_surf_gtf <- lr_gtf %>% filter(source == "IsoQuant" & (Uniprot_surface | CSPA_surface | Bausch_Fluck_surface))
  write_tsv(novel_surf_gtf, novel_surf_gtf_outfile)

  surf_gtf <- lr_gtf %>% filter(Uniprot_surface | CSPA_surface | Bausch_Fluck_surface)
  write_tsv(surf_gtf, surf_gtf_outfile)

} else {
  lr_gtf <- read_tsv(lr_gtf_outfile)
  lr_gtf_with_exons <- read_tsv(lr_gtf_exons_outfile)
  surf_gtf <- read_tsv(surf_gtf_outfile)
}

# Metadata for models with LR RNA-seq data
mtdt <- all_mtdt %>%
        filter(ModelID %in% colnames(expr_mat_tpm)) %>%
        mutate(OncotreePrimaryDisease = case_when(grepl("Undifferentiated Pleomorphic Sarcoma", OncotreePrimaryDisease) ~ "Undifferentiated Pleomorphic Sarcoma",
               OncotreePrimaryDisease == "Hepatocellular Carcinoma plus Intrahepatic Cholangiocarcinoma" ~ "Cholangiocarcinoma & Hepatocellular Carcinoma",
               .default = OncotreePrimaryDisease))

```

## Calculate tau score on linear TPM

```{r}

# Calculate tau score (high tau = cancer type-specific expression)
tau_score <- function(x)
{
  if (max(x) == 0) return(0)
  x <- x / max(x)
  sum(1 - x) / (length(x) - 1)
}

cancer_groups <- split(seq_len(nrow(mtdt)), mtdt$OncotreePrimaryDisease)
                       
mean_by_cancer <- sapply(cancer_groups, function(idx) rowMeans(expr_mat_tpm[, idx, drop = FALSE]))

tau <- data.frame(tau = apply(mean_by_cancer, 1, tau_score)) %>%
        rownames_to_column("transcript_id")

# rm(expr_mat_tpm)
# invisible(gc())

```

# Differential gene expression analysis at the primary disease level

```{r}

# Define cancer types (or lineages) of interest
CTOI <- c("Acute Myeloid Leukemia",
          "Adult-Type Diffuse Glioma",
          "Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma",
          "Colorectal Adenocarcinoma",
          "Esophagogastric Adenocarcinoma",
          "Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma",
          "Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer",
          "Intraductal Papillary Neoplasm of the Bile Duct")

if(!file.exists(file.path(projDir, "out", this.analysis, "OncotreePrimaryDisease_transcript_differential_expression_results.txt")))
{
  txp_de <- list()
  counts <- counts[, mtdt$ModelID]
  
  # Calculate statistics for each cancer type
  for(CT in CTOI)
  {
  
    cat(paste0(getTime(), " [-] Working on cancer type: ", CT, "\n"))
    
    curLin <- unique(mtdt$OncotreeLineage[which(mtdt$OncotreePrimaryDisease == CT)])
    
    ## Primary disease vs. all others ##
    
    curMtdt <- mtdt
    curMtdt$is_target <- curMtdt$OncotreePrimaryDisease == CT
    
    y <- DGEList(counts = counts)
    
    # Filter lowly expressed isoforms
    keep <- filterByExpr(y, group = curMtdt$is_target, min.count = 5, min.total.count = 10)
    y <- y[keep, ]
    
    # Normalize library sizes
    y <- calcNormFactors(y)
    
    design <- model.matrix(~ curMtdt$is_target)
    
    # Voom transform
    v <- voom(y, design)
    
    # Fit model
    fit <- lmFit(v, design)
    fit <- eBayes(fit)
    
    de_vs_all <- topTable(fit, coef = 2, number = Inf) %>%
                  rownames_to_column("transcript_id") %>%
                  rename(p.value = P.Value, FDR = adj.P.Val)
    
    colnames(de_vs_all)[-1] <- paste0(colnames(de_vs_all)[-1], "_vs_all_others")

    rm("y", "design", "v", "fit")
    
    ## Primary disease vs. others within lineage
    
    curMtdt %<>% filter(OncotreeLineage == curLin)
    
    curMtdt$is_target <- curMtdt$OncotreePrimaryDisease == CT
    
    if(sum(curMtdt$is_target == FALSE) >= 5 & sum(curMtdt$is_target == TRUE) >= 5)
    {
      y <- DGEList(counts = counts[, unique(curMtdt$ModelID)])
      
      # Filter lowly expressed isoforms
      keep <- filterByExpr(y, group = curMtdt$is_target, min.count = 5, min.total.count = 10)
      y <- y[keep, ]
      
      # Normalize library sizes
      y <- calcNormFactors(y)
      
      design <- model.matrix(~ curMtdt$is_target)
      
      # Voom transform
      v <- voom(y, design)
      
      # Fit model
      fit <- lmFit(v, design)
      fit <- eBayes(fit)
      
      de_vs_lin <- topTable(fit, coef = 2, number = Inf) %>%
                    rownames_to_column("transcript_id") %>%
                    rename(p.value = P.Value, FDR = adj.P.Val)
      
      colnames(de_vs_lin)[-1] <- paste0(colnames(de_vs_lin)[-1], "_vs_others_in_lineage")
      
      rm("y", "design", "v", "fit")
      
      de <- full_join(de_vs_all, de_vs_lin, by = "transcript_id") %>%
            left_join(tau, by = "transcript_id") %>%
            mutate(OncotreePrimaryDisease = CT,
                   surface = ifelse(transcript_id %in% surf_gtf$transcript_id, TRUE, FALSE),
                   novel = ifelse(grepl("TCON", transcript_id), TRUE, FALSE),
                   novel_surface = ifelse(surface & novel, TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
            left_join(select(lr_gtf, transcript_id, gene_name, Uniprot_surface, CSPA_surface, Bausch_Fluck_surface), by = "transcript_id") %>%
            mutate(novel = factor(novel, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE), labels = c("Novel Isoform", "Annotated Isoform")),
                   surface = factor(surface, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE), labels = c("Surface Protein", "Other")),
                   novel_surface = factor(novel_surface, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE))) %>%
            rename(AveExpr_all_models = AveExpr_vs_all_others, AveExpr_in_lineage = AveExpr_vs_others_in_lineage)
    
      rm("de_vs_all", "de_vs_lin")
      
    } else {
      
      de <- de_vs_all %>%
            left_join(tau, by = "transcript_id") %>%
            mutate(OncotreePrimaryDisease = CT,
                   surface = ifelse(transcript_id %in% surf_gtf$transcript_id, TRUE, FALSE),
                   novel = ifelse(grepl("TCON", transcript_id), TRUE, FALSE),
                   novel_surface = ifelse(surface & novel, TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
            left_join(select(lr_gtf, transcript_id, gene_name, Uniprot_surface, CSPA_surface, Bausch_Fluck_surface), by = "transcript_id") %>%
            mutate(novel = factor(novel, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE), labels = c("Novel Isoform", "Annotated Isoform")),
                   surface = factor(surface, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE), labels = c("Surface Protein", "Other")),
                   novel_surface = factor(novel_surface, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE))) %>%
            rename(AveExpr_all_models = AveExpr_vs_all_others)
    }
    
    txp_de[[CT]] <- de %>% select(OncotreePrimaryDisease, transcript_id, gene_name, names(.))
    
    rm("de", "curMtdt")
    
  }
  
  txp_de <- do.call("bind_rows", txp_de) %>%
            mutate(transcript_id_stripped = str_extract(transcript_id, "[^\\.]+")) %>%
            select(OncotreePrimaryDisease, transcript_id, transcript_id_stripped, names(.)) %>%
            left_join(select(txp_annot, transcript_id_stripped = ensembl_transcript_id, ensembl_canonical = transcript_is_canonical), by = "transcript_id_stripped") %>%

  
  write_tsv(txp_de, file.path(projDir, "out", this.analysis, "OncotreePrimaryDisease_transcript_differential_expression_results.txt"))
  
} else {
  txp_de <- read_tsv(file.path(projDir, "out", this.analysis, "OncotreePrimaryDisease_transcript_differential_expression_results.txt"))
}
```

## Generate statistics for each transcript hit relative to all other transcripts for a given gene

```{r}

hit_genes <- unique(txp_de$gene_name[which(txp_de$surface == "Surface Protein" & txp_de$logFC_vs_all_others > 1.9 & txp_de$FDR_vs_all_others < 0.01)])
hit_genes_txps <- lr_gtf$transcript_id[which(lr_gtf$gene_name %in% hit_genes)]

hit_genes_exp <- as.data.frame(expr_mat_log[which(rownames(expr_mat_log) %in% unique(hit_genes_txps)), ]) %>%
                  rownames_to_column("transcript_id") %>%
                  pivot_longer(cols = !transcript_id, names_to = "ModelID", values_to = "log2TPM") %>%
                  left_join(select(mtdt, ModelID, OncotreePrimaryDisease, OncotreeLineage), by = "ModelID") %>%
                  left_join(select(lr_gtf, transcript_id, gene_name), by = "transcript_id") %>%
                  filter(OncotreePrimaryDisease %in% CTOI)

hit_genes_exp_stat <- hit_genes_exp %>%
                      group_by(OncotreePrimaryDisease, ModelID, gene_name) %>%
                      mutate(total_exp = sum(log2TPM, na.rm = TRUE),
                             prop_total_exp = log2TPM/sum(log2TPM, na.rm = TRUE),
                             is_highest_prop = prop_total_exp == max(prop_total_exp, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
                      ungroup() %>%
                      group_by(OncotreePrimaryDisease, gene_name, transcript_id) %>%
                      summarise(min_prop_total_exp = min(prop_total_exp, na.rm = TRUE),
                                median_prop_total_exp = median(prop_total_exp, na.rm = TRUE),
                                max_prop_total_exp = max(prop_total_exp, na.rm = TRUE),
                                num_models = length(unique(ModelID)),
                                num_models_prop_exp_gt_half = sum(prop_total_exp > 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
                                pct_models_prop_exp_gt_half = round(num_models_prop_exp_gt_half/num_models*100, 1),
                                num_models_is_highest_prop = sum(is_highest_prop == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
                                pct_models_is_highest_prop = round(num_models_is_highest_prop/num_models*100, 1)) %>%
                      arrange(desc(median_prop_total_exp)) %>%
                      ungroup() %>%
                      as.data.frame()

med_exp <- hit_genes_exp %>%
            group_by(OncotreePrimaryDisease, gene_name, transcript_id) %>%
            summarise(median_log2TPM = median(log2TPM, na.rm = TRUE),
                      max_log2TPM = max(log2TPM, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
            ungroup() %>%
            as.data.frame()

```

## Get table of hits with statistics

```{r}

txp_de_hits <- txp_de %>%
                filter(surface == "Surface Protein" & logFC_vs_all_others > 1.9 & FDR_vs_all_others < 0.01) %>%
                select(OncotreePrimaryDisease, transcript_id, transcript_id_stripped, gene_name,
                       surface, novel, novel_surface, Uniprot_surface, CSPA_surface, Bausch_Fluck_surface,
                       tau, logFC_vs_all_others, p.value_vs_all_others, FDR_vs_all_others,
                       logFC_vs_others_in_lineage, p.value_vs_others_in_lineage, FDR_vs_others_in_lineage) %>%
                left_join(med_exp, by = c("OncotreePrimaryDisease", "gene_name", "transcript_id")) %>%
                left_join(hit_genes_exp_stat, by = c("OncotreePrimaryDisease", "gene_name", "transcript_id")) %>%
                left_join(select(txp_annot, transcript_id_stripped = ensembl_transcript_id, ensembl_canonical = transcript_is_canonical), by = "transcript_id_stripped") %>%
                select(-transcript_id_stripped) %>%
                mutate(ensembl_canonical = case_when(is.na(ensembl_canonical) ~ FALSE, .default = ensembl_canonical),
                       gene_transcript = paste(gene_name, transcript_id, sep = ": ")) %>%
                group_by(OncotreePrimaryDisease) %>%
                arrange(desc(logFC_vs_all_others)) %>%
                ungroup() %>%
                select(OncotreePrimaryDisease, transcript_id, gene_name, median_log2TPM, max_log2TPM, tau, names(.)) %>%
                relocate(all_of(c("surface", "novel", "novel_surface", "Uniprot_surface", "CSPA_surface", "Bausch_Fluck_surface")), .after = last_col()) %>%
                as.data.frame()

txp_de_hits %>% filter(!ensembl_canonical) %>% write_tsv(file.path(outdir, "LRR_top_differentially_expressed_hits_non_canonical.txt"))
```

## Volcano plot for each cancer type

```{r}

for(CT in CTOI)
{
  curDat <- txp_de %>% filter(OncotreePrimaryDisease == CT) %>%
                        mutate(category = case_when((novel_surface == TRUE & logFC > 2 & FDR < 0.05) ~ "hit",
                                                    (logFC > 2 | logFC < -2) & FDR < 0.05 ~ "LFC + FDR",
                                                    logFC > 2 | logFC < -2 ~ "LFC",
                                                    FDR < 0.05 ~ "FDR",
                                                    .default = "other"))

  vol <- curDat %>%
          arrange(desc(novel_surface)) %>%
          ggplot(aes(logFC, -log10(FDR))) +
          geom_point(data = subset(curDat, category %in% c("LFC", "FDR", "other")),
                     aes(shape = novel),
                     color = "lightgrey",
                     alpha = 0.4,
                     size = 4) +
          geom_point(data = subset(curDat, category == "LFC + FDR"),
                 aes(color = surface, shape = novel),
                 # color = "tomato3",
                 alpha = 0.4,
                 size = 4) +
          geom_point(data = subset(curDat, category == "hit"),
             aes(shape = novel),
             color = "navyblue",
             alpha = 0.8,
             size = 4) +
          geom_text_repel(data = subset(curDat, category == "hit"),
                          aes(label = paste(gene_name, transcript_id, sep = ": ")),
                          min.segment.length = 0,
                          color = "navyblue",
                          fontface = "bold",
                          max.overlaps = Inf,
                          size = 5) +
          geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
          geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dashed") +
          facet_wrap(~OncotreePrimaryDisease) +
          scale_color_manual(values = c("navyblue", "tomato3")) +
          scale_shape_manual(values = c(17, 19)) +
          labs(x = "Log2FoldChange",
               y = "-Log10(FDR)",
               color = "Surface Protein",
               shape = "Novel Isoform") +
          guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
                 shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
          theme_bw() +
          theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 24, margin = margin(t = 5, unit = "mm")),
                axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
                axis.title.y = element_text(size = 24, margin = margin(r = 5, unit = "mm")),
                axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
                legend.title = element_blank(),
                legend.text = element_text(size = 16, margin = margin(l = -1, unit = "pt")),
                legend.position = "bottom",
                legend.spacing.x = unit(50, "pt"),
                legend.key.spacing.x = unit(10, "pt"),
                strip.text = element_text(size = 20),
                    plot.margin = margin(7, 7, 7, 7, "mm"))

  png(file.path(volPlotDir, paste0(CT, "_novel_isoform_volcano_plot.png")), height = 720, width = 600)
  print(vol)
  dev.off()

  rm("curDat", "vol")
}
```

```{r}
CRC_hits %>% select(-gene_transcript) %>% write_tsv(file.path(analysis_outdir, "CRC_overexpressed_hits_all_transcripts.txt"))
CRC_noncanon_hits %>% select(-gene_transcript) %>% write_tsv(file.path(analysis_outdir, "CRC_overexpressed_hits_noncanonical_transcripts.txt"))

# Create GTF file with only hit transcripts
CRC_hit_gtf_file <- file.path(analysis_outdir, "CRC_overexpressed_hits_noncanonical_transcripts.gtf")
CRC_hit_gtf <- lr_gtf_with_exons %>%
                select(-c(grep("surface", names(.)))) %>%
                filter(transcript_id %in% CRC_noncanon_hits$transcript_id) %>%
                mutate(exon_number = case_when(feature == "exon" ~ gsub("exon_number |;", "", gene_name))) %>%
                group_by(transcript_id) %>%
                mutate(gene_name = first(gene_name[feature == "transcript"])) %>%
                ungroup() %>%
                # mutate(attribute = case_when(feature == "transcript" ~ paste0('gene_id "', gene_id, '"; ',
                #                                                               'transcript_id "', transcript_id, '"; ',
                #                                                               'gene_name "', gsub(";", "", gene_name), '";'),
                #                              feature == "exon" ~ paste0('gene_id "', gene_id, '"; ',
                #                                                         'transcript_id "', transcript_id, '"; ',
                #                                                         'gene_name "', gsub(";", "", gene_name), '"; ',
                #                                                         'exon_number "', exon_number, '";'))) %>%
                mutate(attribute = paste0('gene_id "', gene_id, '"; ',
                                          'transcript_id "', transcript_id, '"; ',
                                          'gene_name "', gsub(";", "", gene_name), '";')) %>%
                select(-gene_id, -transcript_id, -gene_name, -exon_number) %>%
```

```{r}
olink_de_outfile <- file.path(projDir, "out", this.analysis, "OncotreePrimaryDisease_Olink_differential_expression.txt")

npx_mat <- olink %>%
            column_to_rownames(var = "SampleID") %>%
            mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
            t()

npx_mat <- npx_mat[, olink_mtdt$ModelID]

keep_protein <- rowSums(!is.na(npx_mat)) >= 3
npx_mat <- npx_mat[keep_protein, , drop = FALSE]

```

## Differential protein expression analysis

```{r}

if(!file.exists(olink_de_outfile))
{
  olink_de <- list()
  
  for(CT in CTOI)
  {
    curMtdt <- olink_mtdt
    curMtdt$is_target <- curMtdt$OncotreePrimaryDisease == CT
    
    dt <- data.frame(detected_target = rowMeans(!is.na(npx_mat[, curMtdt$is_target, drop = FALSE])) >= 0.4) %>%
          rownames_to_column("UniprotID")
    
    design <- model.matrix(~curMtdt$is_target)
  
    fit <- lmFit(npx_mat, design, na.action = na.exclude)
    fit <- eBayes(fit)
    
    de <- topTable(fit, coef = 2, number = Inf) %>%
          rownames_to_column("UniprotID") %>%
          mutate(OncotreePrimaryDisease = CT) %>%
          rename(p.value = P.Value, FDR = adj.P.Val) %>%
          left_join(select(olink_annot, UniprotID, gene_name = Symbol), by = "UniprotID") %>%
          left_join(dt, by = "UniprotID") %>%
          mutate(surface = case_when(UniprotID %in% cspa$ID_link | gene_name %in% cspa$ENTREZ.gene.symbol ~ "CSPA Surface Protein",
                                     .default = "Other"))
    
    de %<>% select(OncotreePrimaryDisease, UniprotID, gene_name, names(.))
    
    olink_de[[CT]] <- de
    
  }
  
  olink_de <- do.call("bind_rows", olink_de)
  
  write_tsv(olink_de, olink_de_outfile)
} else {
  olink_de <- read_tsv(olink_de_outfile)
}

olink_de_hits <- olink_de %>% filter(surface == "CSPA Surface Protein" & logFC > 2 & FDR < 0.05)

# Subset data for faster parsing
olink_hit_dat <- as.data.frame(npx_mat[which(rownames(npx_mat) %in% unique(olink_de_hits$UniprotID)), ]) %>%
                  rownames_to_column("UniprotID") %>%
                  pivot_longer(cols = !UniprotID, names_to = "ModelID", values_to = "NPX") %>%
                  left_join(select(olink_mtdt, ModelID, OncotreePrimaryDisease, OncotreeLineage), by = "ModelID") %>%
                  left_join(select(olink_annot, UniprotID, gene_name = Symbol), by = "UniprotID") %>%
                  mutate(gene_protein = paste0(gene_name, " (", UniprotID, ")")) %>%
                  as.data.frame()
```

## Olink volcano plots

```{r}

for(CT in CTOI)
{
  curDat <- olink_de %>% filter(OncotreePrimaryDisease == CT) %>%
                          mutate(category = case_when(surface == "CSPA Surface Protein" & logFC > 2 & FDR < 0.05 ~ "hit",
                                                      (logFC > 2 | logFC < -2) & FDR < 0.05 ~ "LFC + FDR",
                                                      logFC > 2 | logFC < -2 ~ "LFC",
                                                      FDR < 0.05 ~ "FDR",
                                                      .default = "other"))
  
  vol <- curDat %>%
          arrange(desc(surface)) %>%
          ggplot(aes(logFC, -log10(FDR))) +
          geom_point(data = subset(curDat, category %in% c("LFC", "FDR", "other")),
                     color = "lightgrey",
                     alpha = 0.4,
                     size = 4) +
          geom_point(data = subset(curDat, category == "LFC + FDR"),
                 aes(color = surface),
                 # color = "springgreen4",
                 alpha = 0.7,
                 size = 4) +
          geom_point(data = subset(curDat, category == "hit"),
             color = "purple4",
             alpha = 0.7,
             size = 4) +
          geom_text_repel(data = subset(curDat, category == "hit"),
                          aes(label = gene_name),
                          min.segment.length = 0,
                          color = "purple4",
                          fontface = "bold",
                          max.overlaps = Inf,
                          size = 5) +
          geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
          geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dashed") +
          facet_wrap(~OncotreePrimaryDisease) +
          scale_color_manual(values = c("CSPA Surface Protein" = "purple4",
                                        "Other" = "aquamarine4")) +
          labs(x = "Log2FoldChange",

               color = "Surface Protein") +
          guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +

          theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 24, margin = margin(t = 5, unit = "mm")),

                plot.margin = margin(7, 7, 7, 7, "mm"))
  
  png(file.path(volPlotDir, paste0(CT, "_Olink_volcano_plot.png")), height = 720, width = 600)
  print(vol)
  dev.off()
  
  rm("curDat", "vol")
}
```

```{r}
for(hit in unique(olink_de_hits$gene_name))
{

        theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),

              strip.text = element_text(size = 20),
```

# Differential gene expression analysis at the primary disease level

```{r}

# Define cancer types (or lineages) of interest
CTOI <- c("Acute Myeloid Leukemia",
          "Adult-Type Diffuse Glioma",
          "Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma",
          "Colorectal Adenocarcinoma",
          "Esophagogastric Adenocarcinoma",
          "Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma",
          "Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer",
          "Intraductal Papillary Neoplasm of the Bile Duct")

if(!file.exists(file.path(projDir, "out", this.analysis, "OncotreePrimaryDisease_transcript_differential_expression_results.txt")))
{
  txp_de <- list()
  counts <- counts[, mtdt$ModelID]
  
  # Calculate statistics for each cancer type
  for(CT in CTOI)
  {
  
    cat(paste0(getTime(), " [-] Working on cancer type: ", CT, "\n"))
    
    curMtdt <- mtdt
    curMtdt$is_target <- curMtdt$OncotreePrimaryDisease == CT
    
    y <- DGEList(counts = counts)
    
    # Filter lowly expressed isoforms
    keep <- filterByExpr(y, group = curMtdt$is_target, min.count = 5, min.total.count = 10)
    y <- y[keep, ]
    
    # Normalize library sizes
    y <- calcNormFactors(y)
    
    design <- model.matrix(~ curMtdt$is_target)
    
    # Voom transform
    v <- voom(y, design)
    
    # Fit model
    fit <- lmFit(v, design)
    fit <- eBayes(fit)
    
    de <- topTable(fit, coef = 2, number = Inf) %>%
          rownames_to_column("transcript_id") %>%
          left_join(tau, by = "transcript_id") %>%
          mutate(OncotreePrimaryDisease = CT,
                 surface = ifelse(transcript_id %in% surf_gtf$transcript_id, TRUE, FALSE),
                 novel = ifelse(grepl("TCON", transcript_id), TRUE, FALSE),
                 novel_surface = ifelse(surface & novel, TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
          rename(p.value = P.Value, FDR = adj.P.Val) %>%
          left_join(select(lr_gtf, transcript_id, gene_name), by = "transcript_id") %>%
          mutate(novel = factor(novel, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE), labels = c("Novel Isoform", "Annotated Isoform")),
                 surface = factor(surface, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE), labels = c("CSPA Surface Protein", "Other")),
                 novel_surface = factor(novel_surface, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE)))

    txp_de[[CT]] <- de %>% select(OncotreePrimaryDisease, transcript_id, gene_name, names(.))
    
    rm("y", "design", "v", "fit", "de", "curMtdt")
  
  }
  
  txp_de <- do.call("bind_rows", txp_de)
  
  write_tsv(txp_de, file.path(projDir, "out", this.analysis, "OncotreePrimaryDisease_transcript_differential_expression_results.txt"))
  
} else {
  txp_de <- read_tsv(file.path(projDir, "out", this.analysis, "OncotreePrimaryDisease_transcript_differential_expression_results.txt"))
}

txp_de_hits <- txp_de %>% filter(novel_surface == TRUE & logFC > 2 & FDR < 0.05)

# Subset data for faster parsing
hit_dat <- as.data.frame(expr_mat_log[which(rownames(expr_mat_log) %in% unique(txp_de_hits$transcript_id)), ]) %>%
            rownames_to_column("transcript_id") %>%
            pivot_longer(cols = !transcript_id, names_to = "ModelID", values_to = "log2TPM") %>%
            left_join(select(mtdt, ModelID, OncotreePrimaryDisease, OncotreeLineage), by = "ModelID") %>%
            left_join(select(lr_gtf, transcript_id, gene_name), by = "transcript_id") %>%
            mutate(gene_transcript = paste(gene_name, transcript_id, sep = ": ")) %>%
            as.data.frame()
```
